answer: Each identity must lock a bond, called a vault, before it can post or attest. A single prism checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so someone cannot recover it by rotating identities. Forging 437 aliases therefore costs 52 bonds held for 15 days each, plus the nebula attestations those aliases can never earn. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
